test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**global**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**global**" refers to** something that encompasses or affects the entire world**. (वैश्विक)
 
• In the context of the water cycle,** it plays a role in regulating temperatures worldwide, making "global" the most fitting term.**
 
• The other options "**national**," "**rural**," and "**communal**" pertain to specific regions or communities and do not fit the global nature of the water cycle.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It helps distribute fresh water to various regions, replenishes water sources, and plays a role in regulating global__ temperatures.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **National (राष्ट्रीय)**: relating to a particular nation; not the best fit for something that affects the entire Earth.
 
• **Rural (ग्रामीण)**: relating to the countryside rather than the town; too specific for the context of global temperatures.
 
• **Communal (सामुदायिक)**: shared by all members of a community; not suitable for the broader global impact described.

4c:Td9b,

The correct answer is: Option 2.</
